android.desc:
WiFi WPS WPA Tester — test WPS PIN vulnerabilities, scan WiFi security, recover saved passwords, analyze WiFi channels, and run speed tests. Free WiFi security toolkit.

Want to know how secure your WiFi really is? WIFI WPS WPA TESTER is a complete WiFi security toolkit: test WPS PIN risks, calculate PINs offline, recover saved passwords, score your network's vulnerabilities, analyze signal quality, and much more.

🔐 WPS PIN Tester
Test your router's WPS PIN against known algorithms and our built-in database. Automatic PIN testing, custom PIN entry, bruteforce mode, and Pixie Dust + Belkin/Arcadyan algorithms on rooted devices.

📲 Offline WPS PIN Calculator
Generate WPS PINs offline from a router's BSSID using 500+ vendor algorithms (Zhao, Belkin, Arcadyan, and more). Works on any Android device. No internet needed.

🔑 Saved Passwords Vault
Access and export passwords of WiFi networks you've previously tested. Share via QR code or copy instantly.

🛡 WiFi Security Scanner & Vulnerability Score
Scan nearby networks and get a 0-100 security score based on encryption (WEP / WPA / WPA2 / WPA3) and WPS exposure. Critical, medium, and safe networks at a glance.

📡 Channel Analyzer
See which 2.4 GHz / 5 GHz / 6 GHz channels are congested around you and pick a cleaner one for better speed and stability.

⚡ WiFi Speed Test
Measure real download, upload, ping, and jitter. Identify your ISP and verify you're getting the speed you pay for.

🏷 Router Identification
Detect router vendor (Cisco, TP-Link, Huawei, Netgear, D-Link, Jio, Airtel and more) from MAC address. Read WPS beacon data including model, serial number, and lock status.

🎓 WiFi Academy
5 levels of gamified WiFi security lessons — Beginner to Master. Learn how WiFi and WPS really work.

📏 Signal Strength & Distance
Live dBm readout and estimated distance from any access point as you move.

Premium (optional)
Remove all ads and unlock the Desktop PC companion for advanced WPS testing from your Windows computer.

Compatibility
• Full WPS PIN testing: works on rooted devices or Android 8 and earlier.
• On Android 9+: the offline WPS PIN calculator, WiFi security scanner, vulnerability score, speed test, channel analyzer, saved passwords, and WiFi Academy all work normally.

Important
Use WIFI WPS WPA TESTER only on WiFi networks you own or are authorized to test. Respect local laws. This app is intended for security education, authorized testing, and research.
